overview_description.description: RMFG builds autonomous sheet‑metal manufacturing and runs an online service for custom components. The platform accepts STEP files, returns instant quotes, and produces laser‑cut parts with optional CNC bending and weldments. Capabilities cover prototypes and small‑batch production for hardware startups. Lead times include expedited options, with two‑day turnaround available on select orders. Software‑driven automation streamlines ordering, fabrication, and delivery.

product.name: Custom Sheet Metal Fabrication Service
product.description: Online service for ordering custom sheet metal parts with instant quotes, including laser cutting, CNC bending, welding, and finishing options.

product.name: Laser Cutting
product.description: Precision laser cutting of sheet metal parts with tight tolerances and instant online quoting.

product.name: CNC Bending
product.description: CNC press brake bending service for custom sheet metal parts with precise bend angles and instant pricing.

product.name: Welding Services
product.description: Professional MIG, TIG, and stick welding services for assembling sheet metal parts.

product.name: PEM Hardware Installation
product.description: Installation of press-fit fasteners and hardware into sheet metal parts.

product.name: Tapping Services
product.description: Thread tapping of holes in sheet metal parts to customer specifications.
